description: Known exceptions to tests/RuiCheck.php. path is relative to the repository ('*' for every file), rule one of palette, px, destructive, empty, destructive-text, match a substring of the flagged text, reason one line.

allow.reason: shadcn-vue's focus ring width, the same on the host's own Button and Input, so a kit control's focus ring matches the host's.
Collapses the whitespace between the two halves of a truncated name; not a type size.
The current page's marker under the bar link, a stroke, not a spacing or type size.
A pale Alert's ground and edge per tone; its text and icon take the *-text tokens (test:token-contrast and semantic-text).
A note's own colour, chosen by its author: a fill, with the theme's foreground for its text.
A NoteCard's colour swatch, the same note colours as the notes feature.
A connection's status line inside its own card, not an empty list.
The navigator's focus target when a filter leaves nothing (tabindex -1), one line inside a narrow pane.
The sample notes widget is scaffolded byte for byte without @kit/ui (test:scaffold); a muted line under its composer.
